title: docs(customization): add an authoring-intent-to-discovery-signal table
body:
# docs(customization): add an authoring-intent-to-discovery-signal table

## Background

Authors deciding how to mark an issue as not-yet-actionable have no
single compact reference mapping their intent to the discovery-visible
signal IDD already honors. `skills/issue-authoring/references/
draft-patterns.md` documents two of four cases (undecided ->
`needs-decision`, waits-on-person/credential -> `blocked-by-human`) in
prose, but `docs/customization.md` -- the file most adopters read for
policy surfaces -- has no such table, and neither location documents
that an order-dependency should become `Blocked by #N`, or that
genuinely-not-ready work should simply stay unreferenced by any open
roadmap.

## Proposed change

Add a compact table to `docs/customization.md` covering all four
intents (undecided, waits-on-person/credential, order-dependency,
not-yet-ready) so authors stop inventing ad hoc "not ready" markers
instead of reusing primitives Discover already understands.

## Acceptance criteria

- `docs/customization.md` has a compact table mapping all four
  authoring intents to their discovery-visible signal.
- The table matches (does not contradict) the existing prose in
  `draft-patterns.md`.
- `node scripts/audit-docs.mjs --check` passes.

## Candidate files

- `docs/customization.md`
- `skills/issue-authoring/references/draft-patterns.md`

---

_Autopilot suitability: 4 / 5 -- higher is more autopilot-suitable;
below the configured floor is human-oriented._
